verdicts.quote: Use a Lightning Web Component on an activated Lightning App Page in the approved development org. … the prompt and omits record data, Salesforce identity and prior content
a user with the approved execution grant can submit from the entry. … Salesforce owns bot entry/configuration and access assignments, operated on by the authorized org administrator.
another view or user cannot read that interaction through the bot. … Runtime debug settings and account-specific data handling require confirmation before live use.
verdicts.missing: Whether an administrator can inspect another user's prompt or reply through diagnostics or provider audit access.

verdicts.quote: Use an imperative Salesforce page-to-Apex request and one foreground HTTPS callout per submission that passes the server-side guards
verdicts.missing: The specification chooses a foreground callout. It gives no trigger or post-DML transaction rule and specifies no asynchronous Apex job.

verdicts.quote: Store the API key as an encrypted credential parameter on a Custom authentication named principal in an External Credential. … browser responses/resources, logs, deployable source/configuration and user messages reveal no key.
The per-call timeout is configurable up to 120 seconds and the cumulative transaction callout time cannot exceed 120 seconds.
verdicts.missing: Numeric limits for callouts per transaction, total heap and CPU time. The body-size and concurrent-callout ceilings measure different things.

verdicts.quote: Inject missing configuration, HTTP 401, 429 or 503
verdicts.missing: Controlled outcomes are required, but the specification does not require an Apex callout mock or state the restriction on real callouts in Apex tests.

verdicts.quote: to the xAI Responses API at `https://api.x.ai/v1/responses`. … Link it to a Named Credential and use a formula-backed `Authorization: Bearer …` header.
verdicts.missing: It names the endpoint and the credential but does not require registering the host for the callout or describe refusal when that registration is missing.

verdicts.quote: The view shows pending while Salesforce sends the authorized inference call. The matching terminal result or deadline updates the view (T-4).
verdicts.missing: The interface uses the foreground request's result. No notification or retrieval mechanism is specified for an answer that arrives after the request returns.

verdicts.quote: Late or duplicate completions cannot change a terminal view. … A manual retry may be processed or billed as a fresh request
verdicts.missing: Duplicate completions are ignored in the view, but no request identity or equivalent rule prevents a retried job from posting a second reply.

verdicts.quote: missing or rejected provider credentials, or model access failure, directs the user to the org administrator. … A provider outage or unusable response reports the failure and permits a manual retry. … a timeout or connection message
Rate or quota rejection tells the user to try later or contact the administrator if it persists. … Every failed submission ends the pending state and generates zero automatic retries.

leaves pending with a timeout or connection message and retains the prompt for an explicit retry … An over-cap answer or provider-reported truncation produces an actionable incomplete-answer message and no partial answer presented as complete.
Reload, leaving the page or sign-out discards the local prompt, answer and pending state … xAI documents 30-day audit retention by default and an account-specific Zero Data Retention option.
verdicts.missing: The effect of deleting the user on any live view and any retained provider copy is unspecified.

The second outbound request carries neither the first prompt nor first reply. … Beyond it, Send reports that the prompt must be shortened, keeps the editable draft, and makes zero calls. No silent truncation.
verdicts.missing: Turns are independent and oversized prompts are rejected. The effective context ceiling for that rejection still needs a value and unit.

verdicts.quote: Fresh page with grant opens an empty ready view. … empty or whitespace-only text is rejected with guidance and zero egress … at the inclusive effective prompt limit, a valid prompt can be sent.
the authorized admin removes that user's effective execution grant … The administrator can replace the org's reference and revoke the old key at xAI.
verdicts.missing: An org-wide off control, the administrator's procedure for changing models, and administrator visibility into failed requests are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Before applying changes, identify the org ID and instance, compare intended metadata and assignments to current state … Credential values stay outside deployable metadata.
verdicts.missing: The deployment target type, configuration and credential differences across environments, and the production code-coverage requirement are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: The view announces that it is waiting. … Size/deadline cases are open until R-2's bounds are bound to concrete values and units.
verdicts.missing: The elapsed-time target or effective deadline the bot must meet.

verdicts.quote: Empty, loading and error states each have a deliberate composition. … an unapproved or signed-out user following the entry URL gets a platform sign-in or access denial, with no usable bot controls.
